messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 4):
"""
Revision in terms and conditions of the products that are warranted exclusively due to the application of any of the updated provisions contained in this circular or the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations,2024 shall be carried out under the extant UIN, with the approval of Product Management Committee(PMC). The PMC shall ensure that the benefits such as waiting period, Moratorium period accrued to the credit of the policyholder are protected and carried forward to the new policy issued. (3) The Insurer may extend the benefits arising out of the revised regulatory framework to the existing policyholders. Chapter I: General Information for the Policy Holder/Prospect/Customer: 1) a.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If my health insurance policy is being revised under the new IRDAI regulations, who must approve the changes and how will my existing benefits be handled?","answer":"The Product Management Committee (PMC) must approve the changes, and any benefits such as waiting period or moratorium period accrued to you will be protected and carried forward to the new policy.","facts":["Revision in terms and conditions of the products that are warranted exclusively due to the application of any of the updated provisions contained in this circular or the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations,2024 shall be carried out under the extant UIN, with the approval of Product Management Committee(PMC).","The PMC shall ensure that the benefits such as waiting period, Moratorium period accrued to the credit of the policyholder are protected and carried forward to the new policy issued."]},{"question":"Can an insurer extend benefits from the revised regulatory framework to existing policyholders?","answer":"Yes, the insurer may extend the benefits arising out of the revised regulatory framework to existing policyholders.","facts":["The Insurer may extend the benefits arising out of the revised regulatory framework to the existing policyholders."]}]}
